items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: I made a thing called 'Jeep Rhythm,' and he recorded it

ctx.x: I see. Maybe we mentioned that before.

Yes. And I made some things for Jimmy. I made some originals, and this is what he was more or less interested in, you know, and I made a thing called 'Jeep Rhythm,' and he recorded it, and it worked out quite well (unintelligible) to us because it was during the war that this thing came out. That's how I -- we arrived at that title, and it did fine.
That was an original of yours?
